item.title: NYC’s Click‑to‑Cancel Rule Bans Sketchy Subscriptions
item.description: New York City’s new click‑to‑cancel law forces any subscription service to let users cancel online as easily as they signed up, promising $21.5‑$162.5 M in annual savings.
